description: Using our creative mind to learn more about space! We love NASA
summary: Our project is based on the “Abandoned but not forgotten” challenge. We created a short video, consisting of three stories that stay unique and untold by the world. They have done significant missions, had heartwarming moments and even allowed us to explore the farthest reaches of space, broadening our vision for the future. We made a video, to tell the story of these equipment, that helped turn dreams, into real exploration! The Cassini spacecraft which showed us the secrets of Saturn, the InSight lander which studied Mars, and the lunar roving vehicle also known as the moon buggy, which exceeded the limits of engineering and showed us new possibilities of what we could uncover on the moon. They show how some things that we don’t pay attention to; are the very reason the innovations and milestones we can reach now are reality. The challenge asked us to narrate the stories of abandoned hardware, we discovered and told the stories of engineering miracles that shape space exploration yet were still hidden in the shadows of new creations, what was once lost can now be found. Learning about these hardware not only makes it cheaper and protects human lives, but it secures humanity’s future.
details: Our project is a video based on three different hardware from NASA (The Lunar Roving Vehicle, The InSight Lander, and The Cassini Spacecraft) We made this so that people will have more knowledge about these equipment- as people often don’t look into the beauty and fascinating science that made these hardware, and discoveries possible. We hope that after people see this video, they can walk away with new understanding about this topic. To develop our project, we used animations, and clips of the Hardware using Flip a Clip and Capcut to edit our video. We also included pictures, a few clips of space, to make the audience engaged. In terms of editing, we also considered about the age-level of the audience, so we tried to make it suitable for all-ages through adding clear information and a few hand-drawn animations to make it creative.
